parsed.description: Discard round-1 run: it edited the protected evaluation section (EVAL_SPLIT='train'), so 1.099894 is not the ground-truth val_bpb and is not comparable to 1.102556. Restore EVAL_SPLIT='val' and make the first legitimate change: halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to roughly double optimizer steps within the fixed 5-minute budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: Round-1 experiment violated the rules by modifying the fixed evaluation section (EVAL_SPLIT='train'); its reported val_bpb is invalid and has been discarded. Evaluation constants are restored to EVAL_SPLIT='val', EVAL_TOKENS=20971520, EVAL_SHARD=10. Only the hyperparameter section will be edited going forward.
